title: 第二十一章剑破迷局处旧怨露真容第二十二章 寒刃对锋刃孤勇敌千军
content_zh:
长安的雪，总带着几分寒凉的算计，落在大理寺的青瓦上，掩盖了檐角未干的血迹，也尘封着一段被刻意掩埋的旧怨。萧琰立在廊下，手中长剑“寒川”凝着霜气，剑穗上的玉坠是母亲唯一的遗物，摩挲间，指尖传来的凉意，远不及心底翻涌的寒意。他如今是长安最年轻的大理寺评事，一身素色官袍衬得身姿挺拔，眉眼间却藏着与年龄不符的沉郁，唯有眼底偶尔闪过的锋芒，似寒剑出鞘，预示着一场即将席卷长安氏族的风暴。
谁也不知，这位凭一己之力考入大理寺、凭断案奇才崭露头角的萧琰，并非孤身一人。他的身后，是十年前一夜之间被灭门的江南萧氏——那个曾手握漕运命脉、却因不愿依附长安氏族而惨遭屠戮的世家。而当年主导这场惨案的，正是以琅琊王氏、清河崔氏、兰陵萧氏（长安分支）为首的长安氏族联盟，他们盘踞长安百年，根系交错，一手遮天，连皇权都要让其三分，江南萧氏的覆灭，不过是他们巩固势力、掠夺利益的一步棋。
萧琰十岁那年，江南萧氏满门被屠，他因被家仆藏于枯井之中，才侥幸逃生。逃亡路上，他亲眼目睹族人的尸体被抛入江中，母亲为护他，身中数刀，临终前将玉坠塞给他，叮嘱他“莫恋仇恨，莫入长安”。可他终究没能守住承诺，十年间，他隐姓埋名，苦学武艺与律法，练就一身本领，只为踏入长安，撕开氏族伪善的面具，让那些沾满鲜血的凶手，血债血偿。他改名换姓，褪去江南萧氏的身份，以寒门子弟的名义，一步步叩开大理寺的大门，只为能借刑狱之权，查清当年灭门案的真相。
长安氏族的嚣张，早已深入骨髓。琅琊王氏掌控漕运与粮道，七成粮草皆经其手，连宫中御膳房的供给，都要看王氏脸色；清河崔氏垄断科举，门生遍布朝野，朝堂半数官员皆出自崔门；兰陵萧氏（长安分支）虽与江南萧氏同宗，却早已投靠王氏与崔氏，靠着出卖宗亲，坐稳了长安世家的位置。三族相互勾结，贪赃枉法，欺压寒门，鱼肉百姓，凡是敢反抗他们的人，皆会离奇失踪或死于非命。此前，有位御史弹劾王氏贪墨漕运银两，第二日便被发现死于家中，对外宣称“暴病而亡”，朝野上下，无人敢再多言。
萧琰初入大理寺时，便察觉到了不对劲。一桩看似简单的商人被杀案，牵扯出王氏旗下的粮行，可案件刚有眉目，关键证人便离奇自缢，卷宗也不翼而飞。大理寺卿虽有察觉，却因忌惮王氏势力，只能不了了之。萧琰看在眼里，记在心里，他知道，长安氏族的迷局，远比他想象的更深，而当年江南萧氏的灭门案，必然与这些看似无关的案件，有着千丝万缕的联系。
他收敛锋芒，步步为营，凭借几桩无人能破的奇案，逐渐获得大理寺卿的信任，也引起了长安氏族的注意。王氏家主王承业，曾派人试探萧琰的底细，见他衣着朴素、言语谦逊，只当他是个急于攀附权贵的寒门子弟，并未放在心上，甚至想将他收为己用，让他成为自己在大理寺的眼线。萧琰顺水推舟，假意依附，暗中收集王氏贪赃枉法、草菅人命的证据，同时，也在寻找当年江南萧氏灭门案的蛛丝马迹。
转机发生在一桩陈年旧案的重审上。有百姓联名上书，请求重审十年前的“江南萧氏通敌案”——当年长安氏族正是以“通敌叛国”的罪名，围剿了江南萧氏。此案当年由崔氏主导审理，卷宗模糊，证据不足，却草草定案，如今被人重提，瞬间引起了朝堂震动。王氏与崔氏得知后，震怒不已，暗中施压，要求大理寺驳回重审请求，可萧琰却主动请缨，要求负责重审此案。
“萧评事，此事凶险，王氏与崔氏绝不会善罢甘休，你何必自寻麻烦？”大理寺卿拉住萧琰，语气中满是担忧，“江南萧氏一案，当年早已定论，再查下去，只会引火烧身。”
萧琰躬身行礼，眼底语气坚定：“大人，律法面前无尊卑，此案疑点重重，若不查清，何以告慰死去的亡魂？何以彰显大理寺的公正？萧琰虽出身寒门，却也知公道自在人心，纵是粉身碎骨，也必当查个水落石出。”
大理寺卿看着他眼中的坚定，终是叹了口气，点了点头：“罢了，你且去查，若有难处，老夫虽能力有限，也必当尽力相助。”
重审之路，步履维艰。萧琰带人前往江南，寻找当年的幸存者，可王氏与崔氏早已派人先行一步，凡是与江南萧氏有关的人，不是被杀害，就是被胁迫，无人敢开口作证。萧琰并未气馁，他沿着当年江南萧氏的漕运路线一路追查，终于在一个偏远的渔村，找到了当年江南萧氏的账房先生。账房先生当年因外出采买，侥幸逃生，这些年一直隐姓埋名，不敢露面。
见到萧琰手中的玉坠，账房先生老泪纵横，终于道出了当年的真相。十年前，江南萧氏掌控着江南漕运，生意兴隆，势力日渐壮大，引起了长安氏族的忌惮。王氏想要吞并江南漕运，多次派人拉拢江南萧氏家主，却被断然拒绝。恼羞成怒之下，王氏联合崔氏、长安萧氏，捏造“通敌叛国”的罪名，暗中调动兵力，围剿了江南萧氏。为了斩草除根，他们下令屠戮满门，销毁所有证据，甚至篡改了当年的漕运账目，将江南萧氏的财产据为己有。
“当年，老夫人（萧琰母亲）为了保护家主的账本，被王氏的人砍中数刀，她拼尽最后力气，将账本交给了我，让我务必保管好，说总有一天，会有人来为萧氏洗刷冤屈。”账房先生颤抖着，从隐秘处取出一本泛黄的账本，“这就是当年的漕运账本，上面记录着王氏挪用漕运银两、勾结外敌的证据，也是他们陷害萧氏的铁证。”
萧琰接过账本，指尖颤抖，泪水无声滑落。十年的隐忍与等待，十年的颠沛与挣扎，终于有了眉目。那些族人的惨死，母亲的遗言，一幕幕在眼前浮现，他紧紧攥着账本，指节泛白，心中的仇恨与悲愤，几乎要将他吞噬。他知道，这本账本，就是刺破长安氏族迷局的利刃，也是他为族人复仇的希望。
返回长安后，萧琰并未立刻揭发真相。他知道，王氏与崔氏势力庞大，仅凭一本账本，未必能将他们扳倒，反而会打草惊蛇，让自己陷入万劫不复之地。他继续假意依附王氏，暗中联合朝中被氏族欺压的寒门官员，以及当年被王氏、崔氏迫害的家族，一步步积蓄力量，同时，他还在账本中发现了一个更大的秘密——当年江南萧氏的灭门案，不仅有王氏、崔氏、长安萧氏的参与，还有宫中某位权贵的身影，而这位权贵，正是当今皇后的父亲，也是崔氏的姻亲。
这一发现，让萧琰更加谨慎。他知道，这场复仇，不仅要对抗长安氏族，还要直面皇权的压力。可他没有退缩，他将账本复印多份，分别交给可靠的盟友，同时，开始整理王氏、崔氏这些年贪赃枉法、草菅人命的所有证据，等待一个最佳的时机，将这一切公之于众。
时机终于来了。元宵佳节，宫中设宴，宴请长安权贵，王氏、崔氏、长安萧氏的家主皆在受邀之列。萧琰借大理寺巡查之名，闯入宫中，手持账本与所有证据，在大殿之上，揭露了长安氏族当年陷害江南萧氏、屠戮满门的真相，以及他们这些年贪赃枉法、勾结外敌的罪证。
“陛下，臣手中的账本，乃是江南萧氏当年的漕运账本，上面清晰记录着王氏挪用漕运银两、勾结外敌的证据；这些卷宗，是王氏、崔氏这些年草菅人命、贪赃枉法的罪证；这位，是当年江南萧氏的账房先生，也是当年灭门案的目击者，他可以作证！”萧琰声音铿锵，目光如刀，扫过殿中惊慌失措的长安氏族家主，“十年前，江南萧氏满门被屠，血流成河，皆是这些人所为！他们以‘通敌叛国’为借口，行掠夺之实，草菅人命，罪该万死！”
殿中一片哗然。王氏家主王承业脸色惨白，厉声呵斥：“萧琰，你胡说八道！你一个寒门子弟，竟敢伪造证据，污蔑我王氏与崔氏，你可知罪？”
崔氏家主崔景渊也附和道：“陛下，此子居心叵测，分明是想挑拨离间，扰乱朝纲，还请陛下下令，将其处死！”

长安萧氏家主萧明远，看着萧琰手中的玉坠，眼中闪过一丝慌乱，随即强作镇定：“陛下，江南萧氏通敌叛国，乃是铁证如山，此子不过是为了报私仇，故意伪造证据，还请陛下明察！”
萧琰冷笑一声，拔剑出鞘，寒剑直指萧明远：“萧明远，你还好意思提及江南萧氏？你身为萧氏子孙，却为了荣华富贵，出卖宗亲，助纣为虐，亲手将江南萧氏推入深渊，你才是罪该万死！当年，我母亲为护我，被你手下的人所杀，你敢说，你不认识我手中的这枚玉坠吗？”
说着，萧琰褪去脸上的易容，露出了江南萧氏嫡子的真面目。萧明远看着他的脸，吓得双腿发软，瘫倒在地，再也说不出一句反驳的话。账房先生也上前一步，当众讲述了当年的所见所闻，与萧琰的话相互印证，那些被萧琰联合的寒门官员，也纷纷上前，呈上王氏、崔氏迫害他们的证据。
皇帝看着眼前的一切，震怒不已。他虽忌惮长安氏族的势力，却也早已不满他们的嚣张跋扈，如今证据确凿，若是再不处置，恐失民心，动摇皇权。当即，皇帝下令，将王氏、崔氏、长安萧氏家主打入天牢，彻查三族，凡是参与当年灭门案、贪赃枉法之人，一律严惩不贷，抄没三族家产，归还江南萧氏被掠夺的财产，为江南萧氏洗刷冤屈。
大殿之上，长安氏族的嚣张气焰荡然无存，那些曾经不可一世的家主，此刻沦为阶下囚，面色惨白，悔不当初。萧琰手持寒剑，立在大殿中央，看着眼前的一切，泪水再次滑落，这一次，却是释然的泪水。十年隐忍，十年追凶，他终于为族人报了仇，为江南萧氏洗刷了冤屈，母亲的在天之灵，终于可以安息了。
雪停了，阳光透过殿门，洒在萧琰身上，驱散了几分寒凉。他手中的寒剑，霜气渐消，剑穗上的玉坠，在阳光下熠熠生辉。长安的迷局，被他一剑刺破，尘封十年的旧怨，终于露出了真容。这场复仇，他赢了，可他也知道，长安的风气，并非一朝一夕就能改变，那些潜藏在暗处的势力，依然在虎视眈眈。
萧琰收剑入鞘，躬身向皇帝行礼：“陛下，江南萧氏的冤屈已雪，萧琰恳请陛下，整顿朝纲，严惩奸佞，还长安一个清明，还天下百姓一个公道。”
皇帝点了点头，目光中满是赞许：“萧琰，你有功于朝廷，有功于百姓，朕封你为大理寺少卿，全权负责整顿朝纲，清查奸佞，朕定当鼎力支持你。”
萧琰再次躬身行礼，眼中闪过一丝坚定。他知道，复仇不是终点，守护天下苍生，还长安一个清明，才是他接下来的使命。剑破迷局，旧怨得雪，往后，他将以剑为盾，以法为刃，守护这世间的公道与正义，不让江南萧氏的悲剧，再次上演。长安的风，终于有了几分暖意，而萧琰的名字，也将随着这场正义的审判，永远留在长安的史册之中。
长安寒雪覆青瓦，大理寺评事萧琰手握“寒川”剑，剑穗玉坠凝着霜气，那是他十年前覆灭的江南萧氏仅存的念想。当年，江南萧氏因拒附长安氏族，被琅琊王氏、清河崔氏与长安萧氏分支联手诬陷“通敌”，满门屠戮，十岁的萧琰凭家仆所救，隐姓埋名十年，终以寒门之身入大理寺，只为昭雪沉冤。
长安氏族盘踞百年，王氏掌漕运、崔氏控科举，长安萧氏卖宗求荣，三族勾结，一手遮天。萧琰收敛锋芒，假意依附王氏，暗中追查，借元宵宫宴之机，持当年账房先生留存的漕运账本——那是氏族挪用银两、构陷萧氏的铁证，闯入大殿揭发真相。
殿上，王氏、崔氏家主厉声狡辩，长安萧氏家主萧明远更是矢口否认。萧琰拔剑出鞘，褪去易容，露出江南萧氏嫡子真容，玉坠为证，账房先生当庭对质，细数当年屠戮惨状。证据确凿，皇帝震怒，下令将三族家主打入天牢，彻查余党，归还萧氏财产。
寒雪渐消，阳光洒在萧琰身上，剑上霜气尽散。十年隐忍，一剑破局，尘封的旧怨终露真容，族人冤屈得雪。萧琰收剑，躬身请命整顿朝纲，以剑为刃、以法为盾，立誓守护长安清明，不让萧氏悲剧重演。

content_en:
The snow in Chang'an always carries a bit of cold calculation, falling on the blue tiles of Dali Temple, covering up the wet bloodstains on the corners of the eaves, and also sealing up an old grudge that was deliberately buried. Xiao Yan stood in the corridor, the long sword "Hanchuan" in his hand condensed with frost. The jade pendant on the sword tassel was the only relic of his mother. As he rubbed it, the coolness coming from his fingertips was far less than the chill in his heart. He is now the youngest judge of Dali Temple in Chang'an. He is dressed in a plain official robe and has a tall and straight figure, but there is a gloominess that belies his age. Only the occasional flash of sharpness in his eyes is like a cold sword unsheathed, indicating a storm that is about to sweep through the Chang'an clan.
No one knew that Xiao Yan, who had been admitted to Dali Temple on his own and had emerged as a prodigy in solving crimes, was not alone. Behind him is the Xiao family of Jiangnan who was wiped out overnight ten years ago - the family that once held the fate of Caoyun but was brutally massacred because they were unwilling to attach themselves to the Chang'an clan. The people who led this tragedy back then were the Chang'an Clan Alliance, headed by the Langya Wang Clan, the Qinghe Cui Clan, and the Lanling Xiao Clan (Chang'an branch). They had been entrenched in Chang'an for hundreds of years, with intertwined roots and one hand covering the sky. Even the imperial power had to be surrendered. The destruction of the Xiao Clan in Jiangnan was just a move for them to consolidate their power and plunder their interests.
When Xiao Yan was ten years old, the entire Xiao family in Jiangnan was massacred. He escaped by chance because he was hidden in a dry well by his servants. On the way to escape, he witnessed the corpses of his tribe members being thrown into the river. His mother was stabbed several times in order to protect him. Before she died, she gave him a jade pendant and told him to "don't love hatred and don't enter Chang'an." But he failed to keep his promise after all. For ten years, he kept his name anonymously, studied martial arts and laws hard, and developed his own skills, just to step into Chang'an, tear off the hypocritical mask of the clan, and let the blood-stained murderers pay with their blood. He changed his name, lost his identity as Xiao from Jiangnan, and opened the door of Dali Temple step by step in the name of a descendant of a poor family, just to use the power of prison to find out the truth about the family extermination case.
The arrogance of the Chang'an clan has already penetrated deep into the bones. The Langya Wang family controls water transportation and grain roads, with 70% of the grain and grass passing through their hands, and even the supply of the royal kitchen in the palace depends on the Wang family; the Qinghe Cui family monopolizes the imperial examinations, with disciples all over the government and the public, and half of the officials in the court are from the Cui family; although the Lanling Xiao family (Chang'an branch) has the same clan as the Jiangnan Xiao family, they have already taken refuge with the Wang family and the Cui family. By betraying their clansmen, they have secured their position in the Chang'an family. The three clans collude with each other, take bribes and bend the law, oppress poor families, and exploit the common people. Anyone who dares to resist them will disappear mysteriously or die violently. Previously, a royal censor impeached the Wang family for embezzling ink and water transportation. He was found dead at home the next day. He announced that he "died of a sudden illness." No one in the government or the public dared to say anything more.
When Xiao Yan first entered Dali Temple, he noticed something was wrong. A seemingly simple murder of a businessman involved Wang's grain store. But as soon as the case came to light, the key witness mysteriously hanged himself and the files disappeared. Although the minister of Dali Temple was aware of it, he could only ignore it because he was afraid of the Wang family's power. Xiao Yan saw it in his eyes and remembered it in his heart. He knew that the mystery of the Chang'an clan was far deeper than he imagined, and the murder of the Xiao clan in Jiangnan must be inextricably linked to these seemingly unrelated cases.
He restrained his sharp edge and worked step by step. With several strange cases that no one could solve, he gradually gained the trust of the ministers of Dali Temple and attracted the attention of the Chang'an clan. The head of the Wang family, Wang Chengye, once sent someone to test Xiao Yan's background. Seeing that he was plainly dressed and humble in speech, he thought he was just a young man from a poor family who was eager to cling to power. He didn't take him seriously. He even wanted to take him into his own hands and make him his informant in Dali Temple. Xiao Yan followed the trend, pretended to be attached, and secretly collected evidence that the Wang family was corrupt, perverting the law, and disregarding human life. At the same time, he was also looking for clues about the Xiao family's murder case in Jiangnan.
The turning point occurred when an old case was retried. Some people jointly signed a letter requesting a retrial ten years agoThe "Jiangnan Xiao Clan's Collaboration with the Enemy Case" - that year, the Chang'an Clan surrounded and suppressed the Jiangnan Xiao Clan on the charge of "collaboration with the enemy and treason." The case was tried by Ms. Cui back then. The files were vague and the evidence was insufficient, but the case was hastily decided. Now that it was brought up again, it instantly caused a shock in the court. When Wang and Cui learned about it, they were furious and secretly put pressure on Dali Temple to reject the request for a retrial. However, Xiao Yan took the initiative and requested to be responsible for retrialing the case.
"Xiao Pingshi, this matter is dangerous. The Wang family and the Cui family will never let it go. Why are you asking for trouble?" The minister of Dali Temple pulled Xiao Yan, his tone full of worry, "The Xiao family case in Jiangnan was already concluded back then. If you continue to investigate, it will only lead to fire."
Xiao Yan bowed and saluted, with a firm tone in his eyes: "Sir, there is no dignity before the law. There are many doubts in this case. If we don't find out, how can we comfort the dead souls? How can we show the justice of Dali Temple? Although Xiao Yan comes from a poor family, he also knows that justice is at home in the heart. Even if his body is broken into pieces, he must investigate and get to the bottom of it."
Seeing the determination in his eyes, the Minister of Dali Temple finally sighed and nodded: "That's all, go check it out. If you have any difficulties, I will try my best to help even though my ability is limited."
The road to retrial is difficult. Xiao Yan led people to Jiangnan to look for survivors, but the Wang family and the Cui family had already sent people to take the lead. Everyone related to the Xiao family in Jiangnan was either killed or coerced, and no one dared to speak up to testify. Xiao Yan was not discouraged. He followed the water transportation route of the Jiangnan Xiao family and finally found the accountant of the Jiangnan Xiao family in a remote fishing village. Mr. Accountant had a lucky escape when he went out for shopping. He has remained anonymous these years and dared not show his face.
Seeing the jade pendant in Xiao Yan's hand, the accountant burst into tears and finally told the truth about that year. Ten years ago, the Jiangnan Xiao family controlled the water transportation in the south of the Yangtze River. Their business was booming and their power was growing day by day, which aroused the fear of the Chang'an clan. The Wang family wanted to annex Jiangnan water transportation and sent people to win over the head of the Xiao family in Jiangnan many times, but was flatly rejected. In anger, the Wang family, together with the Cui family and the Chang'an Xiao family, fabricated the charge of "collaborating with the enemy and treason", secretly mobilized troops, and surrounded and suppressed the Xiao family in Jiangnan. In order to eliminate the root cause, they ordered the massacre of the whole family, destroyed all evidence, and even tampered with the water transportation accounts of the year and took the property of the Xiao family in Jiangnan as their own.
"Back then, the old lady (Xiao Yan's mother) was stabbed several times by the Wang family's people in order to protect the family leader's account books. She used her last strength and handed the account books to me, asking me to keep them safe, saying that one day, someone would come to clean up the Xiao family. Injustice." The accountant trembled and took out a yellowed account book from the secret place. "This is the water transportation account book from that year. It records the evidence that the Wang family misappropriated water transportation silver and colluded with foreign enemies. It is also the ironclad evidence that they framed the Xiao family."
Xiao Yan took the account book, his fingertips trembled, and tears fell silently. After ten years of forbearance and waiting, ten years of ups and downs and struggles, we finally have something to show for it. Scenes of the tragic deaths of those tribesmen and his mother's last words appeared before his eyes. He clutched the account book tightly, his knuckles turned white, and the hatred and grief in his heart almost swallowed him up. He knew that this account book was the sharp blade that pierced the mystery of the Chang'an clan, and was also his hope for revenge for his people.
After returning to Chang'an, Xiao Yan did not immediately reveal the truth. He knew that the Wang family and the Cui family were hugely powerful, and just relying on a ledger might not be able to bring them down. Instead, they would alert the enemy and put him into a situation beyond recovery. He continued to pretend to be attached to the Wang family, and secretly united with officials from poor families who were oppressed by their clans, as well as the families that were persecuted by the Wang and Cui families, to accumulate strength step by step. At the same time, he also discovered a bigger secret in the account book - the murder of the Jiangnan Xiao family not only involved the Wang family, the Cui family, and the Chang'an Xiao family, but also the presence of a certain powerful person in the palace. This powerful person was the father of the current queen and the Cui family.in law.
This discovery made Xiao Yan more cautious. He knew that in this revenge, he not only had to fight against the Chang'an clan, but also faced the pressure of the imperial power. But he did not back down. He made multiple copies of the ledger and gave them to reliable allies. At the same time, he began to sort out all the evidence of Wang and Cui's corruption, perversion of the law, and disregard of human life over the years, waiting for the best time to make it all public.
The time has finally come. During the Lantern Festival, a banquet was held in the palace for the dignitaries of Chang'an. The heads of the Wang family, the Cui family, and the Xiao family of Chang'an were all invited. Xiao Yan broke into the palace under the guise of inspecting Dali Temple, holding the account books and all the evidence. On top of the hall, he revealed the truth about how the Chang'an clan framed the Xiao clan in Jiangnan and massacred the whole family, as well as the evidence of their corruption, perversion of the law, and collusion with foreign enemies over the years.
"Your Majesty, the account book in my hand is the water transportation account book of the Xiao family in Jiangnan back then. It clearly records evidence that the Wang family misappropriated water transportation silver and colluded with foreign enemies. These files are evidence of the crimes of the Wang family and the Cui family over the years of disregarding human life and corruption. This is the accountant of the Xiao family in Jiangnan back then, and he was also the one who wiped out the family. He can testify as a witness to the case!" Xiao Yan's voice was sonorous, and his eyes were like daggers, as he glanced at the panicked Chang'an clan head in the palace, "Ten years ago, the entire Xiao family in Jiangnan was massacred, and it was all caused by these people! They used the excuse of "collaborating with the enemy and treason" to commit plunder, and they deserve death!
There was an uproar in the palace. Wang Chengye, the head of the Wang family, turned pale and shouted sternly: "Xiao Yan, you are talking nonsense! You, a member of a poor family, dare to forge evidence and slander our Wang family and Cui family. Do you know your guilt?"
Cui Jingyuan, the head of the Cui family, also echoed: "Your Majesty, this son has ulterior motives. He clearly wants to sow discord and disrupt the imperial court. Please order his execution!"
Xiao Mingyuan, the head of the Xiao family in Chang'an, looked at the jade pendant in Xiao Yan's hand. A trace of panic flashed in his eyes, and he immediately calmed down: "Your Majesty, the Xiao family in Jiangnan has collaborated with the enemy and treason. There is irrefutable evidence. This son is just for personal revenge and deliberately forged evidence. Your Majesty, please be careful!"
Xiao Yan sneered, unsheathed his sword, and pointed the cold sword directly at Xiao Mingyuan: "Xiao Mingyuan, you still have the nerve to mention the Jiangnan Xiao family? As a descendant of the Xiao family, for the sake of glory and wealth, you betrayed your clan, aided the tyranny, and pushed the Jiangnan Xiao family into the abyss with your own hands. You are the one who deserves death! Back then, my mother was killed by your men to protect me. Do you dare to say that you don't recognize this jade pendant in my hand?"
With that said, Xiao Yan removed the disguise on his face, revealing his true face as the legitimate son of the Jiangnan Xiao family. Xiao Mingyuan looked at his face, his legs became weak with fear, and he collapsed to the ground, unable to utter a word of retort. Mr. Accountant also stepped forward and told the public what he saw and heard that year, which corroborated Xiao Yan's words. Officials from poor families who were united by Xiao Yan also came forward one after another and presented evidence that Wang and Cui had persecuted them.
The emperor looked at everything in front of him and was furious. Although he is afraid of the power of the Chang'an clan, he has long been dissatisfied with their arrogance and domineering. Now the evidence is conclusive. If he does not deal with it, he may lose the support of the people and shake the imperial power. Immediately, the emperor ordered that the heads of the Wang family, the Cui family, and the Chang'an Xiao family be thrown into the sky prison, and the three families were thoroughly investigated. Anyone involved in the family extermination case, corruption and perversion of the law would be severely punished. The family properties of the three families were confiscated, and the plundered properties of the Jiangnan Xiao family were returned to clear the grievances of the Jiangnan Xiao family.
Above the main hall, the arrogance of the Chang'an clan was gone. The once arrogant family heads were now reduced to prisoners, with pale faces and regrets. Xiao Yan stood in the center of the hall with a cold sword in his hand. Looking at everything in front of him, tears fell down again. This time, they were tears of relief. After ten years of forbearance and ten years of pursuing the murderer, he finally avenged his tribe and cleared the grievances of the Jiangnan Xiao family. His mother's spirit in heaven could finally rest in peace.
The snow stopped, and the sunlight shined on Xiao Yan through the palace door, dispersing a fewIt's cold and cool. The frost on the cold sword in his hand gradually disappeared, and the jade pendant on the sword tassel shone brightly in the sunlight. The mystery of Chang'an was pierced by his sword, and the old grudges that had been buried for ten years finally revealed their true colors. He won this revenge, but he also knew that Chang'an's atmosphere could not be changed overnight, and those forces lurking in the dark were still watching.
Xiao Yan sheathed his sword and bowed to salute the emperor: "Your Majesty, the grievances of the Xiao family in Jiangnan have been over. Xiao Yan implores your Majesty to straighten out the affairs of the court, severely punish traitors, and bring a clean day to Chang'an and justice to the people of the world."
The emperor nodded, his eyes full of approval: "Xiao Yan, you have made great contributions to the court and the people. I will appoint you as the Young Minister of Dali Temple. You will be fully responsible for rectifying the imperial court and identifying traitors. I will give you my full support."
Xiao Yan bowed and saluted again, a trace of determination flashed in his eyes. He knows that revenge is not the end, but protecting the world and bringing peace to Chang'an is his next mission. The sword breaks the mystery and the old grudges are resolved. From now on, he will use the sword as a shield and the law as an edge to protect justice and justice in this world and prevent the tragedy of the Xiao family in Jiangnan from happening again. The wind in Chang'an finally felt a bit warm, and Xiao Yan's name will forever remain in the annals of Chang'an along with this just trial.
The green tiles are covered with cold snow in Chang'an. Xiao Yan, the judge of Dali Temple, holds the "Hanchuan" sword in his hand, and the jade pendant of the sword is condensed with frost. These are his only thoughts about the Xiao family in Jiangnan that was destroyed ten years ago. Back then, the Jiangnan Xiao family was framed as "collaborating with the enemy" by the Langya Wang family, the Qinghe Cui family, and the Chang'an Xiao family branch because they refused to join the Chang'an clan. Their entire family was massacred. The ten-year-old Xiao Yan was rescued by his family servants and remained anonymous for ten years. Finally, he entered the Dali Temple as a poor man, just to avenge his injustice.
The Chang'an clan has been entrenched for hundreds of years. The Wang clan controls water transportation, the Cui clan controls the imperial examinations, and the Xiao clan of Chang'an betrays its clan to seek glory. The three clans collude to cover up the sky with one hand. Xiao Yan restrained his sharp edge, pretended to be attached to the Wang family, and pursued the investigation secretly. Taking advantage of the Lantern Palace Banquet, he broke into the main hall to reveal the truth with the water transportation account book kept by the accountant at that time - which was the ironclad evidence that the clan had misappropriated silver and framed the Xiao family.
In the hall, the heads of the Wang and Cui families sternly argued, and Xiao Mingyuan, the head of the Xiao family in Chang'an, even denied it. Xiao Yan unsheathed his sword, took off his disguise, and revealed the true face of the legitimate son of the Xiao family in Jiangnan. The jade pendant was used as evidence. Mr. Accountant confronted him in court and detailed the tragic massacres that year. The evidence was conclusive, and the emperor was furious. He ordered the heads of the three clans to be thrown into prison, the remaining party members were thoroughly investigated, and the Xiao family's property was returned.
The cold snow gradually disappeared, the sun shone on Xiao Yan's body, and the frost on the sword disappeared. After ten years of forbearance, the situation was broken with one sword. The dust-laden old grudges finally came to light, and the people of the clan were vindicated. Xiao Yan sheathed his sword and bowed down to ask for orders to rectify the imperial court. Using the sword as an edge and the law as a shield, he vowed to protect the Qingming Dynasty in Chang'an and prevent the Xiao family's tragedy from happening again.
